display_long_description:
BOB'sLAB is the ultimate VR physics sandbox experience for Quest 2 and Quest 3! Dive into a vast collection of interactive props, powerful weapons, versatile tools, and dynamic NPCs. Experiment with realistic physics in a variety of maps, from sprawling open environments to intricate challenge arenas. Whether you want to create chaotic contraptions, test out creative inventions, or just have fun blowing things up, the possibilities are endless.

Play in solo mode to perfect your creations or jump into multiplayer to collaborate—or compete—with friends in real time. Switch between different game modes, experiment with your favorite gadgets, and watch the world react to your every move. With intuitive VR controls, immersive environments, and limitless creative freedom, BOB'sLAB lets you bring your wildest ideas to life like never before.

Unleash your imagination, master physics, and make every session uniquely yours in BOB'sLAB, the ultimate VR playground.
